card.name: Words just before "reports"
card.fires_on: Small verbs and adjectives such as "been", "were", or "rare" right after "There are/were/have been" or "have", where the next word is likely "reports".

modes.label: have been reported
modes.description: "been" after "have" in adverse-effect statements, before "reported" or "reports".
modes.example: Some quinolones have<< been>> reported to enhance the effects of the oral

modes.label: rare reports
modes.description: "rare" before "reports of" in drug-label adverse-event sentences.
modes.example: There have been<< rare>> reports of serious arrhythmias associated with
